title: Method-reference conversions on Guava and Commons Lang
summary: Java method references widen comparison operands and results, unbox nullable arguments, and respect ComparisonChain short-circuiting.

subject.system: Method-reference conversions on Guava and Commons Lang

change.description: Java method references widen comparison operands and results, unbox nullable arguments, and respect ComparisonChain short-circuiting.

notes: The opening comparison uses the released JARs and Temurin 21.0.13. The standalone, ordinary native, integrated JBMC and physical JVM evidence is measured per statement.

The integrated Guava (0, 1) witness originally exited during replay. The same input now returns a signed negative long through the method reference. A settled ComparisonChain skips null unboxing and a tied chain performs it.
